title: Let's find your gown path
subtitle: Tell me what feels exciting, what feels heavy, and what matters to each of you. I'll turn it into one clear next step.

dashboard.title: Make a decision with Bliss
dashboard.body: Talk through renting, buying off the rack, or ordering custom. Your reasons become the plan—not just another checklist.

intro.title: Start anywhere
intro.body: You don't need a polished answer. A feeling, a budget worry, or a disagreement is enough.
intro.promptCustom: A custom gown feels meaningful, but we're worried about cost and timing.
intro.promptOffrack: We want something special without turning dress shopping into a long project.
intro.promptRent: We care more about ease and flexibility than owning the gown afterward.

composer.privacy: Shared with the two people in this wedding.

decision.contested: Two valid needs are on the table
decision.actions: Prepared for you—never sent without approval
decision.confirmedBody: The next steps now reflect your decision. You can keep talking whenever the choice changes.
decision.keepTalking: Keep talking until this feels shared

feedback.question: Did Bliss represent both of you fairly?
feedback.thanks: Thank you — this helps Bliss get better.

state.error: Bliss couldn't finish that thought. Your message is safe—try again in a moment.

questScoping.genericSubtitle: Choose the feeling first. Bliss will turn it into the few planning steps that actually change.
questScoping.introTitle: Three choices shape this part of the plan
questScoping.introBody: Pick one to start, then tell Bliss why it feels right—or where the two of you differ.
questScoping.leaning: We're leaning toward {choice}. What should we think through together?
questScoping.openBody: Talk through the few choices that change this list. Bliss will keep the reasons and update only the relevant steps.
questScoping.unsupported: This decision companion is not available for this quest yet.

legalLookup.unavailableBody: Bliss has no fresh official-source coverage for this jurisdiction yet, so it will not substitute an estimate. Use the issuing office's current instructions.
